description: Host registry for the shared workspace resolver: an example to replace with your own projects. Reusable resolution logic lives in scripts/resolve-workspace.mjs; this file holds only host-specific mappings (references/registry-format.md). Override per host with --registry, CODEX_WORKSPACE_REGISTRY, or <CODEX_HOME>/workspace-registry.json.

notes: Goals and findings are plain Markdown, with optional plans; a task's checkpoint and small scratch live in its checkout's .state/. Use workspace AGENTS.md for templates and project-owned routes.
